how_to_run: bash repro/run_all.sh   # each finding repro exits 1 while the bug is present

findings.title: RRF host build: standstill bookkeeping is off by one microstep and the next move inherits it
findings.class: emulator bug (RRF fork host-only code path)
findings.root_cause_candidate: RRF/ReprapFirmware/src/Movement/Move.cpp:2276 Move::FreeOldSegments (RRF_HOST_BUILD, fork commit 7eb7a97bf) truncates length+distanceCarriedForwards with (int32_t) while DriveMovement::TakeStepsAndCalcStepTimeRarely (DriveMovement.cpp:750) uses std::lrint
findings.not_settled: exact set of segments/sequences that trip the truncation; ISR/FreeOldSegments interleaving not observed directly

findings.title: RRF CAN CSV with more than one motor per CAN board is misparsed: all motion lost, phantom extrusion instead
findings.root_cause_candidate: rrfFirmwareModel.js:74 keys the map by CAN address and drops the .driver suffix; rrfCanPlayer.js:461-481 _parseCsvRow assumes a fixed 9-column row (parts[6]=steps, parts[7]=acceleration, parts[8]=deceleration) although CanCapture.cpp writes one steps column per drive
findings.not_settled: no bundled machine uses multi-driver CAN addresses, so no shipped preset is affected today

findings.title: Klipper MCU player drops the first queue_step batch of every stepper except the first
findings.class: emulator bug (hp-sim5 default Klipper upload path)

other_shipped_presets.pattern: first-parsed stepper exact, every later stepper loses 0.3-1.0 microsteps

findings.root_cause_candidate: klipperMcuCommandPlayer.js:226 _flushReadyBuckets advances one global nextBucketToEmit per parsed line, while each axis's first queue_step is smeared from MCU tick 0; _emitBucket deletes emitted buckets, so later writes into them are dropped
findings.not_settled: live Klipper streams where an axis first moves mid-print after reset_step_clock (player ignores reset_step_clock)

findings.title: Klipper parsed-line path maps extruder steps to spool axis D; extrusion silently lost
findings.class: emulator bug (hp-sim5 non-default raw/serial Klipper pipeline)
findings.root_cause_candidate: klipperMotionCore.js:42 mapOidToAxis uses DEFAULT_AXIS_ORDER[oid]; applyBucketedParsedLine (line 588) ignores config_stepper step_pin
findings.not_settled: scope: reached only by the opt-in 'raw' pipeline (KLIPPER_UPLOAD_PIPELINE='raw'), playKlipperRawFile and connectKlipperRaw; default 'player' uploads use the pin map and are correct here

negative_results.check: Klipper feedrate/acceleration limits and step counts vs closed form
negative_results.note: span is first-step to last-step, so it is short of the closed form by the half-step at each end; tolerance 20 ms in the script

negative_results.check: RRF move queue stress: 20000 one-microstep absolute moves
Bucketed antialiasing vs exact trapezoid on a real 6400-step Klipper stream
Klipper rejects zero/negative feedrate and G20

details.G20: Machine does not support G20 (inches) command (exit 255)

negative_results.check: RRF G20 units, duplicate moves, zero-length moves

negative_results.details: silently clamped to Config/Configuration.h DefaultMinFeedrate = 0.5 mm/s (10 mm takes 20.0 s); upstream RRF policy

negative_results.check: RRF M204 acceleration change queued between moves (command arriving while moves are pending)

limitations: All evidence is simulation/emulation evidence; F1 is host-build-only and does not exist on real Duet hardware.
F1 trigger set characterised empirically, not derived from an ISR trace.
F2 requires a multi-driver CAN board; no bundled machine does this.
F3 magnitude is bounded by the first queue_step batch (about one microstep in batch dumps); reset_step_clock handling untested.
F4 is on the opt-in raw Klipper pipeline, not the default upload player.
Not tested: interactive HTTP mid-motion commands, arcs, pressure advance, input shaping.

F3_presets.path: hp-sim-3d/app/commandPresetResolver.js resolvePresetCommand -> machine.compiled_commands[gcode].rrf, format FileFormat.RRF_CAN_BINARY; commandJobController.runPreset -> workers.ensureRrfWorker()

F3_uploads.path: hp-sim-3d/index.html accept=.gcode,.txt,.serial,.usda,.csv,.can; handleUpload -> queueCommandFile -> isKlipperFormat -> KLIPPER_UPLOAD_PIPELINE='player' -> ensureKlipperMcuCommandPlayerWorker
F3_uploads.user_action: upload a Klipper MCU dump (.txt/.serial/.log), e.g. public/mcu_commands/slideprinter/draw_squares_bigger_no_buildup.txt or your own klippy.py -o out.serial + parsedump.py output

F2_feed.user_action: upload a .csv or .can capture from RRF/build/rrf_simulator --can-log out.csv (or RRF/csv2can.py / scripts/compile_machine_commands.py output) on a config with two motors on one CAN address, e.g. M584 X40.0 Y40.1
F2_feed.reason: every shipped M584 maps exactly one motor per CAN address

F3_physical_impact.physics_path: createHeadlessWorld(public/usd_scenes/slideprinter.usda), Wasm cable solver, zero gravity, 4000 settle + 400 averaged steps, commands {type:'Move', A,B,C} in radians
F3_physical_impact.direction: almost entirely -Y (towards anchor A at y=-2.1 m)

algebraic_cross_check_mm.note: home point lies in the anchor plane, so z is not first-order observable; the flex forward solver does not converge at this pose and the sim is planar (z=0)

F3_physical_impact.evidence_constant: deficits at 25% and 100% of the stream are identical (B -0.9479, C -0.7920)

failing_unit_repeated.conclusion: bounded 1-step offset, self-cancelling on the next long move; does not accumulate

slideprinter_roundtrips.conclusion: always <= 1 microstep, sign depends on sequence, never grows with n

F1_cumulative.classification_change: severity reduced from 'perturbs subsequent moves' to 'bounded 12.5 um (cartesian) / 0.059 mm-of-line (slideprinter) position error, not a drift'

converted_with_shipped_converter.blocks: one block, count 2 (800 and 400 as values), acceleration read from the Y column

hand_built_correct_two_record_can.records: two int16 items, both CAN id 40, values 800 and 400
hand_built_correct_two_record_can.reason: the record id is the CAN destination address, not the local driver index

F2_binary_path.correction_to_first_pass: the first report wrongly stated that the binary .can path carries a per-drive index; it does not. Multi-driver boards are unsupported end to end.
